description: Enterprise dental DSO brand (rich config, non-strict) — flagship recruiting page for practice owners considering affiliation.

config.toneOfVoice: Confident, collegial, plain-spoken. Speaks dentist-to-dentist, never corporate.
config.targetAudience: Owner-dentists of multi-location practices evaluating DSO affiliation
